Name: effortless-rulebook-editor-runtime
Description: Generic in-container pipeline: rulebook -> Postgres -> read-only Node API + Vite admin portal (with RuleSpeak®, RuleSpeak-DE, and XLSX export tabs). Baked into the effortless-rulebook-editor image; not project-specific.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktopostgres
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate Postgres SQL from the mounted rulebook. mode=check-add is pinned rather than left to the tool's default because this container rebuilds against a live database: check-add emits CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE OR REPLACE + ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE, so a rulebook change adds what is new and upserts rulebook rows without dropping a table or deleting a row. mode=drop-all would wipe every row the user added through the editor; run-rulebook-db-reset.sh refuses to apply drop-all SQL to a running container.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorbac
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Security module: read the ERBRoles / ERBUsers / permission tables and emit rbac/effortless-rbac.json, the database-neutral role model the policy generators compile. Disabled until the Security module is switched on in the portal's Modules page, which enables this step and the policy step together.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rbactopostgrespolicies
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Security module: compile rbac/effortless-rbac.json into postgres/06-rbac-policies.sql -- database roles, grants, row-level security, identity helpers (app.jwt(), app.email(), ...), and one schema per role. Numbered 06 so the database reset step applies it after the data. Never drops a table or schema. Disabled until the Security module is on.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: chmodinitdb
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Prepare the generated database reset script and the stable selector wrapper for execution. The -exec engine accepts only one command token, so this uses a no-argument helper placed in /postgres by container-entrypoint.sh.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: initdb
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Apply the generated SQL to the in-container Postgres DB. The first apply after a container start builds from scratch (the cluster is empty at boot); every rebuild after that is additive -- new tables and columns appear, rulebook rows are upserted, and rows that exist only in the database are left alone. The wrapper refuses the step outright if the generated SQL would drop a table or delete rows, rather than applying it. Uses reset-rulebook-db.sh when present, with legacy init-db.sh compatibility for older rulebook-to-postgres versions. Connection string comes from the DATABASE_URL env var exported by container-entrypoint.sh.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoviteadminportal
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the read-only Vite admin UI, unified with tabs for the Postgres schema, RuleSpeak® (EN/DE), and XLSX export

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoexplainerdag
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the Explainer DAG -- the baked provenance graph the portal uses to make every derived cell clickable (hover for RuleSpeak®, double-click for the full field DAG). The tool namespaces its own output folder, so this lands in admin-portal/public/rulebook-explainer-dag and Vite serves it at /rulebook-explainer-dag/* alongside the portal. NOT optional chrome: the portal loads these five assets from its index.html and its Provenance tab renders nothing without them. Listed AFTER the portal step because it writes inside that step's output directory.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorulespeaken
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the RuleSpeak® document in English only. Disabled by default -- the core-languages step below is the default and always writes to the same /rulespeak output, so running this too would just be wasted work. Turn this on (and disable the other steps) from the portal's language picker or the Admin tab if you want the leanest possible build.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorulespeak
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the RuleSpeak® document in the four core languages -- English, German, Japanese, Hindi (rulespeak.html, in-doc language selector), served under the portal's RuleSpeak® tab. Enabled by default: a focused set keeps the container build fast, and the every-language step below is one click away in the portal's language picker. Rendering is local and deterministic -- no network, no translation service. The portal's language list is derived from the languages= parameter on whichever of these steps is enabled, so editing that list here is all it takes to change what the picker offers.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorulespeakall
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the RuleSpeak® document in EVERY registered language. Disabled by default; the portal's language picker turns this on (and the core-languages step off) when someone asks for the remaining languages. Listed last of the three so that, if more than one is somehow enabled, the widest document is the one left on disk.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoxlsx
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate an Excel workbook snapshot of the rulebook's tables, offered as a download from the portal's Export tab. Enabled by default.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoprogressreport
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Delivery module: render the Progress Report (progress-report.html, narrative.html) from the ERBUserStories / ERBAcceptanceCriteria / ERBBuildPhases tables, shown under the portal's Progress Report tab. Disabled until the Delivery module is switched on in the Modules page.
